purpose: Hand-labeled per-claim gold over a 7-document slice of the frozen HQ-9/P corpus, for the RK-SPIKE identity re-key and the extractor bake-off. Rows are what the documents STATE; absent facts are 'unknown', never inferred.

predicate_vocabulary.<ontology edge_type>: A relationship claim on a declared edge from config/ontology.yaml (based-at, observed-at, inducted-into, imported-by, exported-by, equips, supplies-component, manufactures, design-authority-for, component-of, replenishes).
predicate_vocabulary.same-as / distinct-from: A stated equivalence / stated anti-identity. Routed through the merge channel, not as a triple. object_surface is the other surface form.
predicate_vocabulary.ENTITY_EXISTS: The document asserts an entity of a declared node type exists. object_surface = the node type.
predicate_vocabulary.ATTR:<attr>: The document states a value for a declared attribute of the subject. object_surface = the verbatim value.
predicate_vocabulary.EVENT:<EventType>: The document states an occurrence of a declared event_type. object_surface = the participants.
predicate_vocabulary.UNMODELLED:<desc>: The document states a relation or entity the declared ontology cannot express. A finding, not a failure — recorded so the gap is countable.
predicate_vocabulary.ANTI_COREF:<reason>: Two mentions that must NOT be bound into one referent, where the licence is structural/semantic rather than a stated distinct-from. Negative gold for coref binding.
predicate_vocabulary.AMBIGUOUS:<question>: A pair the document leaves genuinely unresolved. The correct output is the pair surfaced as unresolved with the missing discriminator named — neither a merge nor a distinct-from. The highest-value rows in the slice.
predicate_vocabulary.NOT_A_CLAIM:<reason>: Span that looks claim-shaped but asserts nothing (modal, prospective, meta-commentary, refusal, document noise). NEGATIVE gold: an extractor that emits a claim here commits a precision error.

evidence_modes.stated: The document asserts it in its own voice, unhedged.
evidence_modes.stated-hedged: Asserted, but with an explicit epistemic hedge (reportedly / believed to be / assessed as).
evidence_modes.stated-attributed: The document reports someone else's assertion without endorsing it.
evidence_modes.negative-observation: The document asserts the ABSENCE of something it looked for.
evidence_modes.derived-required: The fact is not stated; reaching it requires inference beyond this document.
evidence_modes.not-a-claim: No assertion is made in this span.

coref_licensing_categories.EXPLICIT_EQUIVALENCE: The document states the identity (apposition, acronym expansion, 'also known as', 'formerly', 'see also', a registry rename).
coref_licensing_categories.NAME_VARIANT: The same designator rendered differently (punctuation, casing, abbreviation, spelling drift).
coref_licensing_categories.UNAMBIGUOUS_ANAPHOR: A definite back-reference with exactly one candidate antecedent in the discourse.
coref_licensing_categories.AMBIGUOUS: The document does not settle whether two mentions co-refer. Highest-value rows.

   OOB-undercount trap (two batteries at one garrison) is not authored.

   seven slice documents state its absence explicitly.

   claiming multi-signal corroboration, and all of its signals sit inside one self-declared aggregator.
